question_text: Explain how a shared Unicode character representation helps a Python application store names written in different scripts.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Unicode assigns code points to characters across many scripts. An agreed encoding represents them as bytes, so compatible systems can preserve the intended text rather than replacing unsupported characters. Unicode is not universally a fixed16-bit encoding.

marking_points.criterion: Encoding represents agreed characters in binary.
